Package eu.algites.lib.action.interaction

Interface AIiActionInteractionProviderMessage<E extends AIiActionInteractionEvent,F extends AIiActionInteractionFeatures,S>

Type Parameters:
E - specialized event contract
F - specialized feature contract
S - specialized interim-state result
public interface AIiActionInteractionProviderMessage<E extends AIiActionInteractionEvent,F extends AIiActionInteractionFeatures,S>
Immutable provider-to-caller snapshot with correlated event and state-result revisions. The state result is independent of the final ActionOutput and may be null or a delta.
